exports.name: lower
exports.behavior: Runs policy validation and canonicalization before emission; assigns dense canonical breadth-first states; emits the frozen scalar, object, array, and Any instruction grammar; builds and rebases key tables; compiles unique patterns in first-state encounter order; resolves registered formats; preserves dense user slots and rejects repeated capture paths; enforces checked global resource limits and encoded image size.

exports.name: compile
exports.behavior: Exactly lower followed by image::validate; does not construct a validation witness itself.

test_vectors: Any instruction operands, header counts, canonical bytes, FNV-1a identity, and default format options.
All six scalar tags; signed integer extremes; decimal policy and bounds; mandatory decimal checks without bounds; zero, one-sided, and u32-max string bounds.
Sorted object properties, dense required bits, unknown-member rejection, member-count bounds, optional captures, and preserved slot numbers.
Empty object tables, empty keys, Unicode keys, common-prefix keys, SWAR fallback, and perfect-hash/global-byte rebasing across multiple object tables.
Canonical breadth-first numbering through aliases, unreachable-node exclusion, shared scalar/object targets, and globally unique property FieldIds.
Array instruction operands and item bounds, finite object/array recursion, and a 1025-state iterative traversal.
Repeated capture rejection through arrays, self-recursion, recursion ancestry, parallel incoming edges, and unequal-depth merging paths; saturated path propagation and unique-owner acceptance.
Raw-container and Any capture metadata, repeated contents inside uniquely captured containers, reused scalar field occurrences, sparse slots, and unreachable slot holes.

Pattern encounter ordering, source deduplication, aggregate and individual pattern-state budgets, empty patterns with zero state budget, malformed and unsupported regex syntax, and UTF-8 pattern byte limits.
Length-pattern-format instruction ordering, all ten stable format identifiers, and unknown/empty/overlong annotations under Reject and Annotate policies.
Inclusive global state/instruction/key/image-byte limits, resource-specific zero limits, policy validation precedence, u32 arithmetic overflow, and malformed internal graph edges.
FieldId 65535 acceptance and larger-ID rejection; 65535 required properties accepted, 65536 required rejected, and 65536 keys accepted when the final property is optional.
Validated byte-identical encodings for reordered property declarations and encoded_len agreement with encoded bytes.

status.validation: Manual source and frozen-contract review only. Inline tests are written but were not executed, as explicitly required.
status.integration: Uses the frozen interfaces for schema IR policy/canonicalization/resolution, compiler keys/patterns/image, and the format registry. Later-wave implementation files were absent when inspected; no substitutes or stubs were introduced.
